resources.string: Your music is in Library. Open it and tap any song to play it.
Tap any song to play it
Visuals turns what you hear into light. Open it to watch the music come alive.
The full transport lives here: play, pause, previous and next.
Drag along the bar to move through the song.
See and reorder what plays next.
Search songs, artists, albums, playlists and saved looks in one place.
Tap a song to play it. Its menu adds it to the queue or a playlist.
It fades after a few seconds. Tap the handle to bring it back, or swipe it up to open Player.
Drag this edge to peek, half or tall. Drag it all the way down to watch full screen.
Styles to choose a look, Customize to shape it, Presets to keep it, MilkDrop for classic presets.
Step to the next or previous style.
Records what you do to the visual while the song plays, ready to render in Studio.
Tap a page name to jump to it, or just keep scrolling.
Find a control by name, roll a new look for the page you are on, or step back.
The ⋮ on a row explains it, resets it, or keeps it when you randomize.
Render makes an MP4, My videos holds your takes and renders, and Edit is the timeline.
Choose what to render, then tap Render. It keeps going if you leave the app.
Everything about the device and the app sits here, one group at a time.
Tutorials replays any screen\'s pointers whenever you like.
Tip: swipe sideways on the visual to change style too.
Tip: double tap the visual to hide or bring back the options.
Tip: you can also hold the visual to start recording.
Tip: swipe the mini player up to open Player.
